name: Kaioken
summary: The kaioken module is a structural module containing the CLI entry point and documentation files (README and CHANGELOG). The only code is bin.ts, which implements the command-line interface with a main async function and a help printer.
keyPoints: The module contains a CLI script (bin.ts) with an async main function and a help output function, plus README and CHANGELOG documentation files.
printHelp() outputs usage instructions to the console, presumably listing available commands and options for the kaioken tool.
main() is the async entry point that parses command-line arguments and orchestrates the tool's execution flow.
The module is labeled 'Structural' suggesting it serves as the top-level orchestrator rather than containing core logic itself.
No library exports are declared — the module's only callable declarations are the CLI functions in bin.ts.
